macros.name: done
macros.doc: A \done command that indicates the thing \todo was already done, allowing to keep it in the document for reference.

macros.name: Todo
macros.doc: A verbose \Todo command that puts its text within the running text.

macros.name: todoclose
macros.doc: \todoopen holds the contents of the beginning mark, and \todoclose the contents of the ending mark.

macros.name: todoenvformat
macros.doc: The text of the todo is formatted by \todoenvformat, that can contain standard declarations (font, size, alignment, etc.).

macros.name: todoformat
macros.doc: All marks, the default or the optional one, are formatted by \todoformat.

macros.name: todoopen
macros.doc: \todoopen holds the contents of the beginning mark, and \todoclose the contents of the ending mark.

macros.name: todos
macros.doc: Command \todos prints the final list that gathers the todo text of all the todos (except todoenv environments, that simply refer to the text).
